_schema.tagA: First tag in the pair (order-independent — engine checks both directions)
_schema.name: Human-readable combo name shown in combat log
_schema.emoji: Visual indicator for the combo pop-up
_schema.priority: Resolution order (lower = resolves first). Same priority = simultaneous.
_schema.effects: Array of effects applied when combo triggers
_schema.conditions: Optional extra conditions beyond just having both tags
_schema.discoveryHint: Flavor text shown first time player triggers this combo
_schema.tier: intro | intermediate | advanced — when player typically discovers this

tagRisks._schema.tag: The tag that carries risk when overcommitted
tagRisks._schema.threshold: Number of cards with this tag played same turn before risk activates
tagRisks._schema.counterTag: Tag that naturally counters or mitigates this risk
tagRisks._schema.resourceDrain: Optional resource cost for overcommit (uses existing ammo/battery/focus/fatigue)

tagRisks.name: Overexertion

counterEffect.note: Improvised cards reduce Overexertion: junk absorbs recoil

tagRisks._designNote: 3+ ballistic cards same turn = Overexertion. Fatigue +2, accuracy drops. Overkill is strong but chain too many physical attacks and you gas out. Improvised cards (junk) absorb the recoil. Teaches restraint — two 🟥 is Overkill (good), three is reckless.

tagRisks.name: Feedback Burn

counterEffect.note: Wet tag acts as heat sink, halves Feedback Burn self-damage

tagRisks._designNote: 3+ electrical cards same turn = Feedback Burn. Self-damage 2 + burns 1 battery. The Arc Surge / Overcharge combo ceiling has a price. Wet cards ground the circuit (half self-damage). Thermal Stabilizer (stolen enemy card) fully negates this. Creates the risk/reward ceiling for Overload Grid chains.

tagRisks.name: Exposure Risk

counterEffect.note: Black Market connections keep your cover intact

tagRisks._designNote: 3+ covert cards same turn = Exposure Risk. Too much sneaky activity draws attention — auto-revealed + Exposed for 2 turns. Ghost Protocol (🟪x2) is safe, but adding a third covert card blows your cover. Black Market cards (illegal contacts) suppress the exposure. Teaches: stealth is a precision tool, not a spam strategy.

tagRisks.name: Slip Hazard

counterEffect.note: Electrical turns the flood into a weapon — risk redirected to all enemies as chain damage

tagRisks._designNote: 3+ wet cards = Slip Hazard. 30% chance you slip (prone = vulnerable) + movement penalty. Flood (🟦x2) is powerful setup, but triple-stacking makes the water dangerous for you too. Electrical follow-up converts YOUR hazard into THEIR problem. Teaches: Wet is setup fuel, not a main course.

tagRisks.name: Instability

counterEffect.note: Electrical precision stabilizes improvised chaos — instability becomes controlled demolition

tagRisks._designNote: 3+ improvised cards = Instability roll. Random outcome from a pool: could reduce combo damage, self-damage, fizzle a card, OR randomly bonus you. High variance. Electrical cards stabilize the chaos. Teaches: junk builds are chaotic — lean into it or ground it with tech.

tagRisks.name: Heat Score

counterEffect.note: Covert tradecraft halves Heat Score — you know how to cover your tracks

tagRisks._designNote: Only 2+ black_market cards triggers Heat Score (lower threshold — illegal gear attracts attention fast). Alert +3, Tracked for 3 turns. Covert cards halve the penalty. Focus drained by paranoia. Deep Cover (⬛x2) is powerful but paints a target. Teaches: Black Market is the premium amplifier, not a foundation — splash it, don't stack it.

combos.name: Arc Surge
combos.discoveryHint: Water conducts electricity — Wet enemies take guaranteed stun and lightning arcs to nearby targets.
combos._designNote: THE tutorial combo. First Wet enemy + Static Shock = 'oh, water makes electricity stronger'. Pokémon Water+Electric logic.

combos.name: Steam Burst
combos.discoveryHint: Fire meets water — steam explosion knocks enemies back and deals bonus impact damage.
combos._designNote: Water + Fire(ballistic) = steam explosion. Removes Wet status but deals burst. Teaches status consumption — combos can eat statuses for big payoffs.

combos.name: Overkill
combos.discoveryHint: Double physical force overwhelms armor — 30% damage reduction ignored plus bonus impact.
combos._designNote: 🟥x2 same turn = Overkill. Quick Strike + Fireball in same turn triggers this. Teaches 'play two of the same type for a bonus'. Simple, satisfying.

combos.name: Backstab
combos.discoveryHint: Strike from the shadows — double damage when attacking from stealth. Reveals your position.
combos._designNote: 🟪+🟥 from stealth = Backstab. Poison Dart (covert) then Quick Strike (ballistic) while stealthed = massive hit. Teaches stealth-as-resource: you spend it for burst.

combos.name: Poison Ignition
combos.discoveryHint: Poison ignites! The toxin detonates — AoE burst clears poison but deals massive area damage.
combos._designNote: Poison + Fire → Explosion. Specifically: target must have Poison status AND incoming card has fire synergyTag. Consumes poison for AoE burst. Pokémon logic: poison is flammable. Teaches status-as-fuel.

combos.name: Stealth Cascade
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised misdirection chains into deeper concealment — next attack gains Backstab bonus.
combos._designNote: 🟩+🟪 = Stealth Cascade. Conceal (covert+improvised) self-combos. Smoke Bomb → Venom Shiv also triggers. Teaches that setup cards chain into payoff cards.

combos.name: Short Circuit
combos.discoveryHint: Jury-rigged electronics overload enemy tech — disables tech-tagged abilities for 2 turns.
combos._designNote: 🟩+🟨 = Short Circuit. Molotov (improvised) + Static Shock (electrical) = disable enemy tech cards. Counters tech-heavy enemies like Datacenter Security and Chem Tech.

combos.name: Shrapnel Spray
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised projectiles fragment into shrapnel — multiple small hits that cause bleeding.
combos._designNote: 🟩+🟥 = Shrapnel. Molotov (improvised+ballistic) self-combos into multi-hit + bleed. Teaches that dual-tag cards can trigger their OWN combos.

combos.name: Toxic Dissolution
combos.discoveryHint: Water dissolves the toxin deeper into the target — poison lasts longer and corrodes armor.
combos._designNote: 🟦+🟪 = Toxic Dissolution. Water Splash on poisoned target = extended poison + armor corrode. Teaches that order matters: poison first, then water to extend. Alternative to Poison Ignition (extend vs detonate).

combos.name: Overcharge
combos.discoveryHint: Double electrical surge overcharges the field — massive chain lightning but the feedback stings you too.
combos._designNote: 🟨x2 same turn = Overcharge. Like Overkill but for electrical — bigger chain lightning, costs 1 self-damage. Teaches risk/reward: double-down for power but take feedback. Pairs with Thermal Stabilizer (stolen enemy card negates self-damage).

combos.name: Flood
combos.discoveryHint: Double water floods the area — everyone gets soaked and movement slows. Perfect setup for electrical follow-up.
combos._designNote: 🟦x2 = Flood. Creates large Flooded ground + Wet on everyone. Massive setup for next-turn electrical combos. Teaches 'invest this turn, payoff next turn' patience.

combos.name: Ghost Protocol
combos.discoveryHint: Double covert triggers Ghost Protocol — full stealth for 2 turns with Backstab on your next two attacks. Silent.
combos._designNote: 🟪x2 = Ghost Protocol. The ultimate stealth commitment. 2 turns of full stealth + double Backstab. Noise immunity means no detection. Advanced players stack Poison Dart + Conceal for massive burst setup.

combos.name: Slick Trap
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised slip hazard — enemies risk falling prone. Prone enemies take bonus damage from follow-up attacks.
combos._designNote: 🟩+🟦 = Slick Trap. Creates slippery ground. Prone enemies take +3 from next hit. Teaches ground-based positional play at advanced level.

combos.name: Jury Rig
combos.discoveryHint: Double improvised triggers a Jury Rig — chaotic bonus effect plus your next card costs 1 less. Unpredictable but fun.
combos._designNote: 🟩x2 = Jury Rig. Random bonus from a pool + cost reduction. The 'chaos' combo for Improvised builds. Rewards players who lean into junk-tag synergies from stolen enemy cards (Dead Battery, Loose Wiring have improvised affinity).

combos.name: Silent Recovery
combos.discoveryHint: Black market goods used covertly — heal without breaking stealth, reduced noise, bonus recovery.
combos._designNote: ⬛+🟪 = Silent Recovery. Dry Martini + any Covert card = heal without revealing position. Teaches that Black Market cards have stealth affinity — luxury goods are discreet.

combos.name: Silent Detonation
combos.discoveryHint: Black market explosives are engineered for silence — no noise, no alert, just damage. The professional's choice.
combos._designNote: ⬛+🟥 from stealth = Silent Detonation. Exploding Cufflink (black_market+ballistic) self-combos when played from stealth: no noise generated, no alert increase. The Q-branch special.

combos.name: Smuggled Tech
combos.discoveryHint: Black market tech is overclocked — electrical effects cost less and last longer. Illegal but effective.
combos._designNote: ⬛+🟨 = Smuggled Tech. Next electrical card costs 1 less + electrical status effects last 1 turn longer. Teaches that Black Market enhances other tags — it's the 'premium modifier' element.

combos.name: Deep Cover
combos.discoveryHint: Double black market triggers Deep Cover — instant stealth, bonus currency, and your next steal attempt is guaranteed.
combos._designNote: ⬛x2 = Deep Cover. The underworld commitment combo. Full stealth + bonus cash + guaranteed steal. Rewards players who invest in Black Market cards. Pairs with Treasure Goblin encounters for maximum loot.

combos.name: Contraband Hack
combos.discoveryHint: Black market parts jury-rigged together — generates a random uncommon card. The street engineer's hustle.
combos._designNote: ⬛+🟩 = Contraband Hack. Generate random uncommon card + cost reduction. The 'resourceful criminal' combo. Dry Martini + Field Stitch Kit or Gentleman's Feint triggers this. Teaches cross-archetype deck building.

combos.name: Adrenal Surge
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised medical gear meets electrical charge — adrenaline surge grants an extra action next turn.
combos._designNote: 🟩+🟨 when medical tag present = Adrenal Surge. Field Stitch Kit (improvised+medical) + any electrical card = +1 action next turn. Specific: needs the medical tag too. Teaches three-way synergy reading.

combos.name: Ignition Mark
combos.discoveryHint: Electrical charge meets a marked target — guaranteed critical hit plus overload. The sniper-hacker one-two punch.
combos._designNote: 🟥+🟨 on Marked target = Ignition Mark. Laser Pen (ballistic, applies Marked) → Taser Baton/Static Shock (electrical) = guaranteed crit. Teaches setup→payoff with specific status requirements.

combos.name: Slipped Mickey
combos.discoveryHint: Black market substances dissolved in water — the target is confused and disoriented. Classic spy drugging.
combos._designNote: ⬛+🟦 = Slipped Mickey. Dry Martini + Water Splash = enemy confused + accuracy down for 2 turns. The classic 'slip something in their drink' spy move. Thematic, effective, teaches Black Market as the social manipulation element.

combos.name: Steam Exposure
combos.discoveryHint: Hitting a Wet target with force creates steam — they're exposed and take +1 damage from the next hit.
combos._designNote: Wet counterplay. When 🟦 target is hit by 🟥 WITHOUT fire tag: Steam Exposure (not full Steam Burst). Wet is no longer pure upside — physical hits convert Wet into vulnerability. Teaches: Wet has a downside if you don't follow up with electrical.

combos.name: Short Circuit Risk
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised gear doesn't play well with electricity — 25% chance of short circuit self-damage or disabling the electrical tag.
combos._designNote: Electrical counterplay via improvised interaction. When 🟩+🟨 collide WITHOUT a Wet grounding tag: 25% chance of backfire. This makes Short Circuit (COMBO-007) a risk/reward combo — you get the tech-disabling benefit but might hurt yourself. Wet cards ground the circuit (eliminate the risk). Creates a natural counter triangle: Electrical > Wet > Improvised > Electrical.

combos.name: Expendable Ordnance
combos.discoveryHint: Disposable weapons hit harder when you're not holding back — bonus damage, pierced armor, and salvaged ammo.
combos._designNote: THE core 'disposable as ammo' combo. Exploding Cufflink self-combos (ballistic+disposable in synergyTags). Also fires cross-card: Flashbang + Quick Strike same turn. Ammo refund makes disposable-ballistic plays resource-positive. Teaches: burning cards IS the resource loop.

combos.name: Burn Notice
combos.discoveryHint: Spent assets leave no trail — temporary stealth, a clean exit, and composure regained. The agency disavows all knowledge.
combos._designNote: Disposable + covert = Burn Notice. 4 cards self-combo: Violin Wire, Stolen Technique, Fumbled Grab, Sabotage (all have disposable+covert in synergyTags). Also cross-card: any disposable + any covert card. Makes the 'use it and lose it' spy fantasy tangible. Noise reduction means disposable ops are quieter. Focus refund (composure from clean tradecraft) matches the resource loop pattern of all other disposable combos. Stacks with Ghost Protocol for massive stealth burst.

combos.name: Overclocked Gadget
combos.discoveryHint: Burning out the gadget overloads the circuit — guaranteed stun and some juice salvaged from the wreckage.
combos._designNote: Camera Flash self-combos (electrical+disposable). Cross-card: Sabotage + Static Shock, Recon Scan + Taser Baton. Battery refund makes disposable-tech plays sustainable. The 'overclock a gadget to destruction' trope. Pairs with Surge Protector for near-infinite electrical chains.

combos.name: Dead Drop
combos.discoveryHint: Disposable black market goods leave a dead drop behind — cash and intel from the wreckage.
combos._designNote: Exploding Cufflink self-combos (black_market+disposable). Cross-card: any disposable + Dry Martini. Currency generation makes disposable builds fund themselves — burn cards, gain money, buy more cards. The spy's economic engine. Intel reveal adds tactical value to every burn.

combos.name: Field Salvage
combos.discoveryHint: Scrapping disposable gear yields spare parts — a new improvised tool and cheaper follow-up.
combos._designNote: Pure cross-card combo: any disposable + any improvised (Molotov, Conceal, Field Stitch Kit, Gentleman's Feint, Containment Protocol). Generates a random common card + cost reduction. The 'dumpster dive' combo — burn something, find something new. Feeds Jury Rig (🟩x2) if generated card is also improvised. Self-sustaining junk loop.

combos.name: Evidence Wash
combos.discoveryHint: Disposable evidence meets water — all traces washed away. Marks, tracking, exposure cleared.
combos._designNote: Disposable+Wet = Evidence Wash. Disposable item + Water Splash or Spark Puddle = cleanse all tracking debuffs. Focus refund from the 'clean getaway' composure. Completes the disposable combo matrix: now every core tag (ballistic, electrical, covert, black_market, improvised, wet) has a disposable partner combo.

combos.name: Controlled Burn
combos.discoveryHint: Improvised accelerants turn a small flame into a controlled inferno — area denial plus cheaper follow-up.
combos._designNote: Fire+Improvised = Controlled Burn. Molotov (both tags) self-combos. Cross-card: Fireball + Conceal, Fireball + Field Stitch Kit. Creates fire ground + DoT. The 'fire' tag had 4+ cards but was only accessible via Poison Ignition conditions — this gives it a direct combo path. Cost reduction rewards improvised chains.

combos.name: Silent Surge
combos.discoveryHint: A silent electrical charge from the shadows — guaranteed stun and disable without breaking cover's silence.
combos._designNote: Electrical+Covert from stealth = Silent Surge. Taser Baton (ballistic+electrical) + Poison Dart (covert) after Conceal. Or Spark Puddle (wet+electrical) + Smoke Bomb (covert). Noise reduction means the electrical attack is quiet. Fills the gap between Smuggled Tech (⬛+🟨) and Backstab (🟪+🟥) — gives electrical builds a stealth option. Advanced tier because it requires stealth setup.

combos.name: Combo Strike
combos.discoveryHint: Back-to-back melee — the momentum builds into a free finishing blow that staggers the target.
combos._designNote: melee×2 same turn = Combo Strike. Like Overkill (ballistic×2) but for hand-to-hand. Jab→Haymaker, Jab→Jab, Quick Strike→Taser Baton all trigger this. Most intuitive discovery: punch twice to unlock free third hit. Teaching: same-tag-twice = escalation, the universal combo grammar.

combos.name: CQC Takedown
combos.discoveryHint: Strike quietly and the target never sees it coming — execute window opens wider and they're left bleeding.
combos._designNote: Melee+Covert = CQC Takedown. The stealth-action genre signature move. Sleeper Hold (melee+covert) self-combos. Venom Shiv (covert+ballistic+melee) also fires this. Cross-card: Jab/Haymaker + Poison Dart/Conceal. Execute threshold bonus rewards patiently whittling the target down. Bleed ensures even a failed takedown bleeds out over time. Noise reduction fits the silent killer fantasy.

combos.name: Inferno
combos.discoveryHint: Two flames merge — fire spreads to all nearby enemies and burns hotter than either alone.
combos._designNote: fire×2 same turn = Inferno. Fireball→Incendiary Round, Molotov→Fireball, Incendiary Round×2. AoE burn spread punishes enemies clustered together. Like Overkill/Overcharge for fire tag — same-tag-twice escalation. Teaches: fire cards feed each other. Incentivizes fire-heavy builds and makes the Pyromaniac encounter symmetrically playable — they Inferno you, you can Inferno them.

combos.name: Bind & Blast
combos.discoveryHint: The rope holds them in place — your next shot can't miss.
combos._designNote: Rope (bind tag) into Basic Shot (ranged_chain tag). +20 accuracy for next ranged attack + bound target is Exposed for 1 turn. Long but simple chain — bind first, then finish with ranged. Teaches setup → payoff sequencing.

combos.name: Salvage Rights
combos.discoveryHint: The lever breaks something useful loose — scrap and a stagger.
combos._designNote: Broken Lever (structural + black_market) following melee. Drops 2 scrap resource and staggers enemy. Reinforces the 'improvised tools as black market barter' theme.

combos.name: Ghost Passage
combos.discoveryHint: The hidden passage swallows the sound — move through unseen.
combos._designNote: Secret Button (environmental_trigger + covert) while undetected. Enemy repositions silently, no noise generated, stealth maintained. In player hands: silent reposition with -5 noise. Rewards reading the environment.

_catalogNote:
Tag Synergy Combo System v6.0. v1: Core Pokémon-logic combos. v2: Black Market tag combos. v3: Counterplay depth — tag risk profiles, counterplay cards, risk/reward punishment combos. v4: Disposable-as-ammo system — 5 new combos (COMBO-025 through COMBO-029) making one-time-use cards the fuel for tag synergies. v5: Stress-test remediation — COMBO-026 Burn Notice gained focus refund, COMBO-030 Evidence Wash, COMBO-031 Controlled Burn, COMBO-032 Silent Surge. v6: CQC expansion — COMBO-033 Combo Strike (melee×2, intro), COMBO-034 CQC Takedown (melee+covert, intermediate), COMBO-035 Inferno (fire×2, intermediate). 35 combos total. Melee tag now has full combo ecosystem matching ballistic/electrical/covert patterns.

[environment-synergy] Added Bind & Blast (bind+ranged_chain), Salvage Rights (structural+black_market), Ghost Passage (environmental_trigger+covert) combos for Rope / Broken Lever / Secret Button card chains.
